      range:

      - 0.025
      default: 0.015
      binds_to:
      - path: termination.pose_tolerance
        mode: replace
    arc_height:

      range:
      - 0.08
      - 0.25
      default: 0.15
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.arc_height
